x: James, Tasker, Oliver and Robins were second in the handicap team race and our "A" Team with Sapcote, Bellchamber, McMullen and East were third in the handicap team race.

(James, Bellchamber, Sapcote, Oliver.) To add our own footnote to this report, our thanks are due to all those who helped to make the race a success, to those who gave so generously to the prize fund, to Arthur Whitehead for providing accommodation and refreshments for our own walkers and to the Lic…
The team of Belgrave Policemen who won the M.P.A.A. 10 Miles Team Championship—Sapcote, Evans, McGreechan and Atkinson. Harry Greene 1st in the Inter Schools race for the Densham Cup.

At seven miles Proctor was well away in the lead, Charlie and Mac still 5th and 6th, Readman 12th, Oliver 18th, Sapcote 20th, Bidgood 24th, Bentley 26th, Wright 28th, with Clayton taking it easy owing to a strained leg.
Pat Sapcote was determinedly chasing three Woodford men and the odds seemed that he would catch them, in fact he assured us that it was in the bag, and he certainly did it.

Eight miles was reached by Clayton in 70.36, closely followed by McGreechan, Wright and Checkley; 350 yards behind came Bidgood, Bellchambers, Shields and Rutland, and a further 200 yards Wakeley and Readman, closely followed by Sapcote, Sutton and Robins.
